['Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value', 'From activities', 'Inner Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Inner Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Inner Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Inner Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='", 'Filter activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null', 'Filter target_dictionary.tid = 1844', "Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'", "Filter assays.assay_type = 'B'", "Filter activities.type = 'IC50'", 'Order By molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id', 'Limit 1000']
